answer: Each identity must bond collateral in a vault, so multiplying names does not create free voting power. When evidence links k identities to coordinated equivocation, the penalty scales as O(k²), reflecting the pairwise conflicts, while detection applies an exponential multiplier to the swarm’s capital loss. Asymmetric depreciation makes recovery costly; like an orchard exposed to a rising tide, coordinated exposure compounds rather than diversifies risk.
